en.name: Avocado oil
en.summary: Unopened avocado oil keeps 2 years from purchase in a cool dark cupboard, and about 6 months once opened. Oil fails by going rancid, not by growing anything, and the clock speeds up the moment air gets into the bottle.
en.pantry: 2 years from purchase unopened, and 6 months after opening, in a cool dark cupboard with the cap tight. The difference between those two numbers is the whole story of oil storage: a sealed bottle has almost no oxygen in it, while an opened one has a headspace that grows every time you pour. Light, heat and air are the three drivers of oxidation, which is why a dark bottle stored away from the hob outlasts a clear one on a sunny shelf regardless of the date. Unrefined extra virgin avocado oil, which keeps its green colour and grassy flavour, goes first; refined avocado oil is more stable and takes high heat better.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published for avocado oil. Refrigeration will slow oxidation, and it is a reasonable choice for an unrefined bottle you use only occasionally — but the oil will cloud and thicken in the cold, which is harmless and reverses at room temperature. If you cook with it daily, a cool dark cupboard away from the stove is the more practical home, and buying a smaller bottle does more for quality than chilling a large one.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for avocado oil and there is no reason to freeze it. Oil does not freeze solid, so nothing is gained in convenience, and a bottle taken in and out of the freezer only collects condensation. Water in an oil bottle is a genuine problem: it gives spoilage organisms something to work with in a food that otherwise has none.
en.thawing: Let a chilled bottle stand at room temperature until it is clear and pours freely. Never warm an oil on the hob or in hot water to speed that up — heat is exactly what ages it.
spoilage: A sharp, crayon or paint-like smell — rancid oil, and decisive.
A bitter, scratchy finish at the back of the throat.
A flat, waxy taste where an unrefined oil used to be grassy and green.
Cloudiness that does not clear at room temperature, or visible water in the bottle.
tips: Buy a bottle size you will finish within a few months of opening.
Keep it away from the hob; the cupboard above the stove is the worst place in the kitchen.
Use unrefined avocado oil cold and refined avocado oil for high heat.
Close the cap immediately after pouring — the headspace is what ages the oil.

faq.q: How long does avocado oil last?
faq.a: 2 years from purchase unopened, and about 6 months once opened, kept cool, dark and tightly capped.

faq.q: Does avocado oil need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No, though it slows oxidation and suits a bottle you use rarely. It will cloud and thicken in the cold, which is harmless and clears at room temperature.

faq.q: How do you know avocado oil has gone off?
faq.a: Smell it. A crayon or paint-like note means it is rancid, and it will taste bitter and scratchy. Rancid oil is a quality failure, not a pathogen risk.

zh.name: 酪梨油
zh.summary: 未開封的酪梨油自購買日起放陰涼避光處可放 2 年，開封後大約 6 個月。油的失敗方式是油耗，不是長東西；而只要空氣進到瓶子裡，時鐘就會走得更快。
zh.pantry: 未開封自購買日起 2 年、開封後 6 個月，放陰涼避光的櫃子，瓶蓋鎖緊。這兩個數字之間的差距，就是油品保存的全部道理：未開封的瓶子裡幾乎沒有氧氣，而開過的瓶子有一段每倒一次就變大的頂空。光、熱和空氣是氧化的三個推手，所以一瓶收在遠離爐火處的深色瓶，不管日期如何，都會比曬得到太陽的透明瓶撐得久。保留綠色和青草香的未精煉初榨酪梨油壞得最快；精煉酪梨油比較穩定，也更耐高溫。
zh.fridge: 酪梨油沒有公布的冷藏期限。冷藏確實能拖慢氧化，對一瓶只偶爾用的未精煉油是合理的選擇——但低溫下它會變濁、變稠，這無害，回到室溫就會恢復。如果你天天用它做菜，遠離爐火的陰涼櫃子才是比較實際的位置；而且與其把大瓶冰起來，不如直接買小瓶，那對品質的幫助更大。
zh.freezer: 酪梨油沒有公布的冷凍期限，也沒有冷凍的理由。油不會凍成硬塊，使用上沒有任何好處；而一瓶進進出出冷凍的油只會一直結露。油瓶裡有水是真正的問題：它會在一個本來沒有水的食物裡，給腐敗菌一點可以利用的東西。
zh.thawing: 把冰過的瓶子放室溫，等它恢復清澈、可以順利倒出即可。絕對不要為了加速而拿去爐火上或泡熱水——熱正是讓油老化的元凶。
spoilage: 聞起來刺鼻、像蠟筆或油漆味——那就是油耗，而且是決定性的。
入口後喉頭有苦味和刮喉感。
原本青草味十足的未精煉油，變得扁平、帶蠟味。
回到室溫仍然不清澈，或瓶子裡看得到水。
tips: 買開封後幾個月內用得完的容量。
遠離爐火；爐台上方那個櫃子是全廚房最糟的位置。
未精煉的用在冷食，精煉的才拿去高溫烹調。
倒完立刻鎖蓋——讓油老化的就是那段頂空。

faq.a: 未開封自購買日起 2 年，開封後大約 6 個月，要陰涼避光、瓶蓋鎖緊。
不一定要，但冷藏能拖慢氧化，適合很少用的那瓶。低溫下會變濁變稠，那是無害的，回到室溫就清了。
聞一下。像蠟筆或油漆的味道就是油耗，吃起來會苦、會刮喉嚨。油耗是品質問題，不是病原菌風險。
